text.p: Investors should buy shares of Poland's Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych SA (BIG), which is set to form a strong group offering a broad range of services, the brokerage unit of Bank Handlowy SA said.

"Taking into account the current and past results of Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych as well as its development prospects and strategy, we recommend to investors with intermediate investment horizons to buy shares of the company," Handlowy said in a report dated November 22 and released on Monday.
The share closed at 3.9 zlotys on Tuesday December 24, the last session before the Christmas break.
Handlowy said BIG's plan to take over other financial service entiies would help it compete against domestic and foreign competition.

It said BIG was already benefitting from its takeover of ailing Bank Big SA, whose deposits were an important source of financing the parent's assets, and that the parent was likely to increase its credit portfolio in the next two years.
But Handlowy said BIG would best decrease its liabilities to other financial institutions, which were at 44 percent in the 1995-1996 turnover year.
It said BIG would lift net profit to 81.9 million zlotys next year from 55.2 million zlotys in the last year, ending September 30, 1996.
It said interest income would rise to 145.7 million zlotys next year from 127.5 million zlotys in 1996.
